what: How each default endpoint refuses a trace for the tracer-bullet transaction.
why: Ticket 03 names four capabilities; three are served free and traces are not. This file is the evidence, in each vendor's own words, measured rather than argued. The nodies message is a commercial refusal and names a price; the blastapi one is a policy refusal; the mevblocker one is a Cloudflare-fronted proxy declining the request before a node sees it. Those are three different problems with three different owners, which is why transport keeps the text instead of collapsing them into 'RPC failed'.
